premise: Bee finds something sweet and wiggles a funny dance; Caterpillar and Ladybug think it's just a dance and join in, until they follow where the dance points and find Flower.
inspiration: A Just So question ("why does the bee dance?", Kipling), answered truly instead of tall.
lesson: Listen to what a friend is really trying to tell you.
learning: Bees do a little dance to show other bees where the flowers are.

en-US.title: Bee Dances the Way
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Bee came {sfx:buzz} buzzing home, fizzing with news. {bee:face happy} She had found something SWEET, and she wanted to tell her friends. [excited] So she did what bees do: {bee:live hum} she hummed her tune and danced a wiggly dance. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Caterpillar crawled up to watch. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] "What a funny dance!" {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Ladybug came too. "Can we dance?" So they all wiggled. {caterpillar:live wiggle} Wiggle, waggle, wiggle! {ladybug:live wings} Ladybug even {sfx:flutter} fluttered her wings and took a bow. {bee:face sad} [sighs] "No, no," said Bee. "It's not just a dance. It's a bee map! It shows the way to the flowers." {bee:live waggle-dance} She danced it again, wiggling one way. {caterpillar:live look-up} Caterpillar reared up tall to look. [curious] "That way?" {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} "That way!" And there, just where the dance said, was a yellow {flower:enter} flower. {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Off they went: buzz, crawl, flutter! {flower:face happy} [happily] "Hello!" said Flower. {caterpillar:face surprised} "Your dance was right!" said Caterpillar. {all:hop} So they danced again, {flower:wobble} Flower too. Wiggle, waggle… SWEET!

es-ES.title: El baile de Abeja
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {bee:enter} Abeja volvió {sfx:buzz} zumbando, loca de contenta. {bee:face happy} ¡Había encontrado algo DULCE, y quería contárselo a sus amigas! [excited] Así que hizo lo que hacen las abejas: {bee:live hum} tarareó su canción y se puso a bailar, meneándose. {caterpillar:enter} {caterpillar:go to bee} Oruga se acercó a mirar. {caterpillar:face happy} [giggles] —¡Qué baile tan gracioso! Y llegó {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:go to bee} Mariquita: —¿Podemos bailar? Y se menearon todas. {caterpillar:live wiggle} ¡Meneo por aquí, meneo por allá! {ladybug:live wings} Mariquita hasta {sfx:flutter} batió las alas e hizo una reverencia. {bee:face sad} [sighs] —Que no, que no —dijo Abeja—. ¡No es un baile, es un mapa de abeja! Dice por dónde se va a las flores. {bee:live waggle-dance} Lo bailó otra vez, hacia un lado. {caterpillar:live look-up} Oruga se estiró bien alta para mirar. [curious] —¿Por allí? {bee:face happy} {bee:hop} —¡Por allí! Y allí, justo donde decía el baile, había una {flower:enter} flor amarilla. {bee:go to flower} {caterpillar:go to flower} {ladybug:go to flower by fly} Y allá fueron: zumbando, reptando, volando. {flower:face happy} [happily] —¡Hola! —dijo Flor. {caterpillar:face surprised} —¡Tu baile tenía razón! —dijo Oruga. {all:hop} Y volvieron a bailar, {flower:wobble} Flor también. Meneo por aquí, meneo por allá… ¡y qué DULCE!

ja-JP.title: ミツバチさんの ちずダンス
ja-JP.text: {bee:float loop 0.4}{bee:enter}ミツバチさんが、{sfx:buzz}ぶんぶん、うきうき、かえってきました。{bee:face happy}あまーいものを見つけたから、なかまにおしえたいの。[excited]そこで、ミツバチらしく、{bee:live hum}はなうたをうたって、ふりふりダンス！{caterpillar:enter}{caterpillar:go to bee}あおむしさんが、もぞもぞ見にきました。{caterpillar:face happy}[giggles]「おもしろいダンス！」 {ladybug:enter}{ladybug:go to bee}テントウムシさんも、「おどっていい？」 みんなで、ふりふり。{caterpillar:live wiggle}くねくね、ふりふり！{ladybug:live wings}テントウムシさんは、{sfx:flutter}はねをぱたぱた、ぺこりとおじぎまで。{bee:face sad}[sighs]「ちがうの、ちがうの」 とミツバチさん。「これは、ミツバチのちずなの！花のあるところを、おしえてるのよ。」 {bee:live waggle-dance}もういちど、あっちのほうへ、ふりふり。{caterpillar:live look-up}あおむしさんが、ぐーんとのびあがって、[curious]「あっち？」 {bee:face happy}{bee:hop}「あっち！」 ほんとうに、ダンスのとおりのところに、きいろい{flower:enter}お花！{bee:go to flower}{caterpillar:go to flower}{ladybug:go to flower by fly}ぶーん、もぞもぞ、ぱたぱた！{flower:face happy}[happily]「こんにちは！」 とお花。{caterpillar:face surprised}「ダンス、あたってた！」 とあおむしさん。{all:hop}みんなでまたおどりました。{flower:wobble}お花も、いっしょに。ふりふり、くねくね…あまーい！

buzz.prompt: a bee buzzing close by, happy and busy, realistic

flutter.prompt: tiny insect wings fluttering, very light and quick, close
